title: Purchase-Visit Kit Price Reference for Adjustment Kits — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Kit price reference.** On an Alignment Services & Plans plan, the kit charge of the parts listed on the plan's latest work order follows the plan's **purchase-visit kit price**: the parts charge of the plan's alignment included in the plan and dated on the plan's purchase date. The calendar days that separate the plan's purchase date from the visit decide which tier applies.

| Store listed parts on the visit | Purchase-visit kit price | Calendar days from the purchase date to the visit | Kit charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | above 0.00 | no more than 90 | the lower of the listed price and the purchase-visit kit price |
| Yes | above 0.00 | more than 90 but no more than 365 | the listed price less half of any amount by which the listed price exceeds the purchase-visit kit price |
| every other case (no parts listed, a purchase-visit kit price of 0.00, or more than 365 days) | | | the listed price |

### Worked cases (hypothetical; purchase-visit kit price 60.00)
| Days since purchase | Listed price | Kit charge |
|---|---|---|
| 90 | 80.00 | 60.00 — the lower of the two |
| 90 | 50.00 | 50.00 — the lower of the two |
| 91 | 80.00 | 80.00 less half of 20.00: 70.00 |
| 365 | 50.00 | 50.00 — no excess over 60.00 |
| 366 | 80.00 | 80.00 |

With a purchase-visit kit price of 0.00 (no parts on the purchase visit), the kit charge is the listed price at any age.
